exposure: timing of VP shunt placement relative to MMC closure
cohort: The study included 81 infants (47 females and 34 males) with hydrocephalus due to meningomyelocele who underwent ventriculoperitoneal (VP) shunt surgery.
finding: Hydrocephalic infants with meningomyelocele undergoing VP shunt surgery face significant risks of infection and mechanical complications, with methicillin-resistant coagulase-negative staphylococcus being the most common pathogen and male gender significantly associated with long-term shunt infections.
